name: Computer Science (BCS)

requirements.label: Introduction to computing
requirements.note: The sample schedule lists CS 108 as normally required. CS 106 or CS 104 may be accepted with advisor approval.

requirements.label: STAT 243
requirements.note: The sample schedule says “or alternative” but does not name the alternative. If STAT 243 is absent, verify any substitute with your advisor.

requirements.label: CS 195
requirements.note: The sample schedule lists this zero-credit seminar repeatedly. Three distinct completed academic periods are marked complete; this does not verify attendance in the exact required terms.

courseGroups.label: Lab Science
courseGroups.note: The BCS program page requires 6 hours of ABET-compatible natural science. Options shown here are limited to courses listed under Natural Sciences in the selected catalog whose Calvin course descriptions explicitly mention laboratory work or a lab fee. A lab listing alone does not establish ABET compatibility; confirm eligible courses with your advisor.

manualRequirements.label: Overall degree and core requirements
manualRequirements.note: This page checks listed course records only. It does not evaluate total degree hours, core requirements, or the official program audit.
